basic_details.short_information: The recruitment is for apprenticeship training for the year 2026-27 under the Apprenticeship (Amendment) Act, 1973. Candidates who passed the prescribed qualification during 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 or May 2026 and are from Tamil Nadu can apply, subject to the other eligibility conditions in the notification.

age_limit.details: The age limit will be followed as per the Apprenticeship Rules. Specific minimum/maximum age figures are not specified in the notification.

qualification.details: Qualifying degree/diploma must have been passed during 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025, or May 2026, and candidates must hail from Tamil Nadu. | Not Eligible: Candidates who have already completed, or are currently undergoing, apprenticeship under the Apprenticeship (Amendment) Act 1973, or who have one year or more of relevant experience, are not eligible to apply.

salary_details.details: Graduate Apprentices (Engineering and Non-Engineering): Rs. 12,300 per month Diploma in Engineering (Technician) Apprentices: Rs. 10,900 per month

selection_process: Shortlisting will be carried out by the Board of Apprenticeship Training (Southern Region) based on the percentage of marks obtained in the qualifying/basic prescribed qualification relevant to each discipline. Shortlisted candidates will be notified through their registered email ID. Shortlisted candidates must appear for Certificate Verification at the TNSTC Trichy Region office (tentatively scheduled for the fourth week of September 2026). The list of shortlisted candidates will be published on the NATS portal (Home page → Regional Events → BOAT Southern Region → Apprenticeship News).
how_to_apply: Applications must be submitted online through the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS) portal at nats.education.gov.in. The process differs based on whether the candidate is already enrolled on the portal.
Visit https://nats.education.gov.in and click Student, then Student Login.
Click Forgot Password and enter your registered email ID to receive an activation link and reset your password.
Log in with your registered email ID and new password, and complete the application form.

Under "Apply against advertised vacancies," search for the relevant organization name (e.g., "TAMILNADU STATE TRANSPORT CORPORATION VILLUPURAM LTD," "TNSTC KUMBAKONAM," "TNSTC SALEM SALEM REGION," "TAMILNADU STATE TRANSPORT CORPORATION MADURAI LTD MADURAI REGION," "TAMIL NADU STATE TRANSPORT CORPORATION LTD TIRUNELVELI REGION," "METROPOLITAN TRANSPORT CORPORATION CHENNAI LTD," or "STATE EXPRESS TRANSPORT CORPORATION TN LTD").
Click Apply. The application status will show as "Applied."
Visit https://nats.education.gov.in, click Student, then Student Register.
Complete the application form to generate a unique 12-digit Enrolment Number (ATN...).
Log in with your registered email ID and password.
Under "Apply against advertised vacancies," search for the relevant organization name as listed above.
Click Apply, and upload the required Provisional Certificate/Consolidated Mark Sheet along with the percentage of marks or CGPA x 10.
Confirm the application status shows as "Applied."
important_instructions: No TA/DA will be paid for attending certificate verification. No boarding or lodging expenses are admissible. On completion of the apprenticeship period, the corporations have no obligation to offer employment, nor can an apprentice claim a right to employment on the grounds of completing the apprenticeship. Incomplete or erroneous online applications received after the due date will be rejected; no further communication will be entertained. BOAT (Southern Region) has not authorized any individual or organization to coordinate or liaise on its behalf. Candidates should beware of touts. Canvassing or pressuring through any source will disqualify the candidature, and the candidate's name will be removed from official records without prior intimation. For clarifications or enrollment verification queries, contact [email protected].

Candidates holding an engineering degree or diploma can also explore more Engineering Government Jobs and Diploma Apprentice Jobs across India. Graduates in Arts, Science, or Commerce can check the latest Tamil Nadu Government Jobs and Graduate Apprentice Jobs 2026 for more openings. Candidates interested in transport and public sector apprenticeships can also browse PSU Apprentice Recruitment 2026 and Chennai Government Jobs matching their qualification.

content_sections.heading: TNSTC MTC SETC Apprentice Recruitment 2026-27 Notification Out
content_sections.text: Tamil Nadu State Transport Corporation, Metropolitan Transport Corporation Chennai, and State Express Transport Corporation Tamil Nadu have jointly released the official notification for engagement of Apprentices for 2026-27 under the Apprenticeship (Amendment) Act, 1973. The notification includes complete details about region-wise training slots, eligibility criteria, stipend, selection procedure, and important dates. Eligible candidates can apply online through the NATS portal until 28-08-2026. Candidates can use the direct link below to download the official notification PDF and read all recruitment details. Download TNSTC MTC SETC Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF Apply Online Link Official Website

content_sections.heading: TNSTC MTC SETC Apprentice Recruitment 2026-27 - Overview
content_sections.text: The recruitment is for apprenticeship training for the year 2026-27 under the Apprenticeship (Amendment) Act, 1973. Candidates who passed the prescribed qualification during 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 or May 2026 and are from Tamil Nadu can apply, subject to the other eligibility conditions in the notification.

content_sections.heading: TNSTC MTC SETC Apprentice Recruitment 2026-27 Important Dates
content_sections.text: Candidates should complete the online application by 28 August 2026. The shortlisted candidates list is scheduled for the second week of September 2026, while certificate verification at the TNSTC Trichy Region office is tentatively scheduled for the fourth week of September 2026.

rows.date: Fourth week of September 2026 (Tentative), at TNSTC Trichy Region Office

content_sections.heading: TNSTC MTC SETC Apprentice Vacancy 2026-27 Details
content_sections.text: A total of 1,518 apprenticeship training slots are available across three categories: Graduate Engineering, Diploma Engineering, and Non-Engineering Graduate. Note: The participating corporations reserve the right to increase or decrease the number of vacancies mentioned in this notification. Open to candidates with a First Class Degree in Engineering/Technology (B.E./B.Tech, Regular Full-time). Open to candidates with a Diploma in Engineering/Technology (Regular Full-time). Open to candidates with a Degree in Arts/Science/Commerce/Humanities (BA/BSc/BCom/BBA/BBM/BCA etc., Regular Full-time, UGC approved). Note: TNSTC Salem does not have a listed vacancy under the Graduate (Non-Engineering) category in the notification. The corporations reserve the right to increase or decrease the number of vacancies mentioned above.

content_sections.heading: TNSTC MTC SETC Apprentice Recruitment 2026-27 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualifying degree/diploma must have been passed during 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025, or May 2026, and candidates must hail from Tamil Nadu. Not Eligible: Candidates who have already completed, or are currently undergoing, apprenticeship under the Apprenticeship (Amendment) Act 1973, or who have one year or more of relevant experience, are not eligible to apply.

rows.qualification_required: Degree in Engineering/Technology (Regular Full-time) with First Class from a Statutory University, an institution empowered by an Act of Parliament, or a professional body examination recognized as equivalent by the State/Central Government
Diploma in Engineering/Technology (Regular Full-time) from a State Council/Board of Technical Education, a University, or an institution recognized as equivalent by the State/Central Government
Degree in Arts/Science/Commerce/Humanities (BA/BSc/BCom/BBA/BBM/BCA etc.), Regular Full-time, from a UGC-approved Statutory/Deemed University

content_sections.heading: TNSTC MTC SETC Apprentice Recruitment 2026-27 Age Limit
content_sections.text: The age limit will be followed as per the Apprenticeship Rules. Specific minimum/maximum age figures are not specified in the notification.

Shortlisted candidates will be notified through their registered email ID. Shortlisted candidates must appear for Certificate Verification at the TNSTC Trichy Region office (tentatively scheduled for the fourth week of September 2026). content_sections.heading: How to Apply for TNSTC MTC SETC Apprentice Recruitment 2026-27
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted online through the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS) portal at nats.education.gov.in . The process differs based on whether the candidate is already enrolled on the portal. Visit https://nats.education.gov.in and click Student, then Student Login. Click Forgot Password and enter your registered email ID to receive an activation link and reset your password. Log in with your registered email ID and new password, and complete the application form. Under "Apply against advertised vacancies," search for the relevant organization name (e.g., "TAMILNADU STATE TRANSPORT CORPORATION VILLUPURAM LTD," "TNSTC KUMBAKONAM," "TNSTC SALEM SALEM REGION," "TAMILNADU STATE TRANSPORT CORPORATION MADURAI LTD MADURAI REGION," "TAMIL NADU STATE TRANSPORT CORPORATION LTD TIRUNELVELI REGION," "METROPOLITAN TRANSPORT CORPORATION CHENNAI LTD," or "STATE EXPRESS TRANSPORT CORPORATION TN LTD"). Click Apply. The application status will show as "Applied." Visit https://nats.education.gov.in, click Student, then Student Register. Complete the application form to generate a unique 12-digit Enrolment Number (ATN...). Log in with your registered email ID and password. Under "Apply against advertised vacancies," search for the relevant organization name as listed above. Click Apply, and upload the required Provisional Certificate/Consolidated Mark Sheet along with the percentage of marks or CGPA x 10. Confirm the application status shows as "Applied."

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in TNSTC MTC SETC Apprentice Recruitment 2026-27?
faq.answer: A total of 1,518 vacancies are available: 457 for Graduate Engineering Apprentices, 438 for Diploma (Technician) Apprentices, and 623 for Graduate Non-Engineering Apprentices.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for TNSTC MTC SETC Apprentice Recruitment 2026-27?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online is 28.08.2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the monthly stipend for TNSTC apprentices?
faq.answer: Graduate Apprentices receive Rs. 12,300 per month, and Diploma (Technician) Apprentices receive Rs. 10,900 per month.

faq.question: Q4. Who is eligible to apply for TNSTC MTC SETC Apprentice Recruitment 2026-27?
faq.answer: Graduates and Diploma holders in Engineering, and Graduates in Arts/Science/Commerce/Humanities, who passed in 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025, or May 2026 and hail from Tamil Nadu, are eligible.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for TNSTC MTC SETC Apprentice Recruitment 2026-27?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through the NATS portal at nats.education.gov.in.

faq.question: Q6. What is the duration of the TNSTC apprenticeship training?
faq.answer: The apprenticeship training is for a period of one year, as per the Apprenticeship (Amendment) Act 1973.

faq.question: Q7. Is there an age limit for TNSTC MTC SETC Apprentice Recruitment 2026-27?
faq.answer: The age limit follows the Apprenticeship Rules; specific age figures are not mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q8. Where will certificate verification for shortlisted TNSTC apprentice candidates take place?
faq.answer: Certificate verification will be held at the TNSTC Trichy Region office, tentatively in the fourth week of September 2026.
